entries.title: 写ルンです感的室内抓拍写真
entries.note: 日文提示词，来自图片 ALT；需上传人物参考图，先用引用帖做初图。
entries.prompt: 縦9:16。写ルンですで撮影したようなフォトリアルな実写スナップ写真。24歳の成人女性。持ち込み画像の顔立ち、表情、目の色、髪型、髪色、長さ、前髪、分け目、毛流れ、毛量、体格を完全維持。アニメ調にしない。  ベージュ色の壁、濃い木製ドア、天井照明のある生活感の残る室内。  女性はカメラの真正面に立ち、首をわずかに傾け、眠たげな表情でレンズを見つめる。右腕を胸の前に横向きに重ね、右手と前腕で胸元を完全に覆う。左手では深緑色のレースブラジャーの肩紐を指先でつまみ、身体の横に自然に垂らしている。  下半身は濃紺のデニムジーンズ。腹部とへそが見える構図。胸元は腕と手で完全に遮蔽し、乳首や乳輪は一切見えない。  カメラは女性の約80cm前方、胸の高さ。28mm相当の近距離広角撮影。頭から腰下まで収める。わずかに傾いた水平線と不完全なフレーミングで、目の前で撮影したような臨場感。  写ルンです特有の強い直射フラッシュ。顔と肩、腕に不均一な光が当たり、背後の壁に輪郭のはっきりした影が落ちる。肌の明るい部分は軽く白飛びするが、顔の造形は鮮明に残す。  35mmフィルム特有の粗い粒状感、微妙な色かぶり、周辺減光、わずかな手ブレ、暗部のざらつき。肌の毛穴や自然な凹凸を残す。  過剰な美肌補正、CG的光沢、人工的なボケ、映画風照明、HDR、完璧すぎる構図を禁止。偶然撮れたような生々しい日常のフィルム写真。

entries.prompt: 縦9:16。2015年頃のiPhone 6背面8MPカメラで撮影したフォトリアルな無加工実写写真。24歳の成人女性。持ち込み画像の顔立ち、目の色、髪型、髪色、長さ、前髪、分け目、毛流れ、毛量、体格を完全維持。アニメ調にしない。  薄暗い室内。黒い布張りのソファに仰向けで寝転がる女性。身体の下には淡いグリーンの柄入りタオル。画面上部には暗いチェック柄の布。自然光による柔らかな陰影。  女性は上半身を斜めに倒し、左腕をカメラ方向へ大きく伸ばして自撮りしている。右腕は身体の横に自然に置く。顔をレンズへ向け、目を大きく開いてカメラを直接見つめる。唇をわずかに開けた落ち着いた表情。    胸の左右には黒地に赤い唇模様が入ったハート形小さめの布製アップリケを一つずつ配置。画面左下側と右上側に離して配置し、元画像の位置関係、大きさ、傾きを忠実に再現する。  カメラは女性の伸ばした左手による近距離自撮り。顔を画面左上、鎖骨と肩を中央、胸元を右側から下部に大きく配置。身体が画面を斜めに横切る構図。元画像の顔の角度、腕の伸ばし方、身体の傾きを最優先。  iPhone 6特有の29mm相当の広角、8MPの柔らかな解像感、自然な肌の毛穴、暗部ノイズ、軽い白飛び、わずかな手ブレ。美肌補正、CG光沢、HDR、人工的なボケ、映画風照明は禁止。文字、ロゴ、透かしなし。SFW。

entries.title: GTA VI 罪恶都市通缉令海报
entries.note: 长提示词，可替换成自己的人物。
entries.prompt:
GTA VI | VICE CITY MOST WANTED | CINEMATIC POLICE DOSSIER

Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic Vice City Police Department MOST WANTED poster, inspired by the fictional law-enforcement universe of Grand Theft Auto VI. The design should resemble an authentic police-issued fugitive dossier, blending vintage Miami crime culture, modern police intelligence graphics, and premium Rockstar-style promotional artwork.

1. SUBJECT & IDENTITY

Use the uploaded photograph as the facial identity reference. Preserve the subject's recognizable facial features, facial structure, skin tone, and natural appearance.

Completely change the subject's pose, facial expression, body language, and outfit. Give them a confident, charismatic, slightly intimidating personality with the presence of an international fashion model. Avoid stiff, lifeless mugshot expressions.

2. WARDROBE & STYLING

Replace the original clothing with a distinctive, fashion-forward outfit inspired by luxury Miami streetwear and modern crime-drama aesthetics. Experiment with bold colors, interesting patterns, statement jackets, premium fabrics, and stylish accessories. Ensure the outfit feels unique, sophisticated, and perfectly suited to Vice City's atmosphere.

3. WANTED POSTER & POLICE DETAILS

Feature the subject's portrait as the primary identification photograph, integrated into a professionally designed police dossier.

Include fictional details such as:

- VICE CITY POLICE DEPARTMENT — MOST WANTED
- Suspect's full name and criminal alias
- Case identification number
- Threat classification: EXTREME
- Physical description and criminal reputation
- Last known whereabouts: Vice City
- Outstanding arrest reward: $5,000,000
- Official police stamps, case references, and classification markings.

Arrange everything with realistic police-document formatting and clear visual hierarchy.

4. VISUAL STYLE & ATMOSPHERE

Capture Vice City's signature combination of glamorous Miami culture and gritty criminal underworld. Incorporate subtle distressed paper textures, retro-inspired police paperwork, modern investigative graphics, neon-inspired accents, cinematic shadows, sophisticated typography, and authentic-looking document markings.

Maintain a balanced composition with the portrait as the dominant element and supporting police information integrated naturally.

5. FINAL QUALITY

The finished poster should feel like an official leaked police dossier from the GTA VI universe, with photorealistic skin details, natural imperfections, realistic lighting, premium graphic design, and cinematic depth.

Rendering: Ultra-high-resolution 8K, vertical 4:5 composition, photorealistic quality, sharp typography, and professional art direction.

Avoid: Generic wanted templates, unchanged clothing or poses, artificial-looking faces, excessive decorations, cluttered layouts, illegible text, and obvious AI-generated aesthetics.

CREATIVE DIRECTION: Make the subject look like Vice City's most notorious and stylish fugitive — someone whose name commands attention across the entire city.

entries.title: 希腊小巷三角梅下的时装大片
entries.prompt:
fashion editorial in a narrow Greek island alley at harsh midday, with chalk-white stone walls, a weathered cobalt door, and an enormous fuchsia bougainvillea spilling overhead.

An adult woman stands midway up a paint-marked wooden ladder, framed from just below the knee upward so she remains dominant while the flowers press tightly around the top and sides of the image.

She wears an blue poplin halter dress with a close sculpted waist, broad open back, and a short softly structured skirt, paired with dark brown leather sandals and small hammered-gold earrings. Style her hair in a compact low twist with an irregular side part, leaving the neck and shoulders clear.

One hand steadies the ladder while the other holds a small pair of garden shears beside a freshly cut bougainvillea branch. Loose petals cling to one shoulder and scatter across the stone below. She turns down toward the camera with a slightly breathless, amused expression, as if interrupted halfway through the task.

Photograph from close below ladder height, slightly off-axis, with the cobalt doorway cutting into one edge of the frame and dense flowers filling the opposite side.

Hard Mediterranean sun creates sharp leaf-and-flower shadows across the white wall, her bare shoulders, and the dress. Preserve sun-faded paint, limewashed stone, dry petals, cotton structure, worn ladder wood, natural skin, and restrained film grain.

entries.author: CandyTravelight
entries.title: 同一提示词比真人皮肤质感
entries.note: 左 GPT Image 2，右 Nano Banana 2.1。
entries.prompt:
【主体设定】虚构的20岁成年东方女性，身高175cm，沙漏型身材，上身曲线优美，腰臀比明显，双腿纤细笔直，自然比例。青春感，看起来就是20岁的大二学生，脸颊饱满有胶原蛋白，皮肤紧致有光泽，脸部线条圆润柔和，不显成熟；柔和脸型带一点苹果肌，眼睛清澈明亮笑起来弯弯，眉形自然平直，裸色水润唇，妆极淡。深棕色长发半扎发，用黑色缎带蝴蝶结固定，下半部长发披在肩后，有空气刘海和碎发。亮橙色修身罗纹针织短袖，U领，露出锁骨和肩颈线；黑色高腰紧身瑜伽裤，贴腿到脚踝；薄荷绿色厚底老爹鞋。不穿外套，不披外套。
【场景动作】夜晚的高级酒店高层休息厅，落地窗外是城市夜景，她站在窗边，右手拿着一杯热拿铁，被朋友的话逗笑的抓拍瞬间，侧头看向窗外，左手自然下垂，双手自然放松，五根手指完整清晰、比例正常。
【视觉风格】iPhone 随手抓拍质感。
【构图镜头】2:3 竖版，中景半身偏全身，平视，人物在右三分线，35mm，f/1.8，轻微胶片颗粒。
【光影色彩】室内暖色灯光侧光加一圈轮廓光，脸部亮部与阴影有层次；主色亮橙和黑，跳色薄荷绿；肤色自然通透，色温约3800K。
【材质细节】真实毛孔和细小绒毛，自然高光，脸颊淡淡红晕，左右脸轻微不对称，眼睛有反光，唇上有细纹，眉毛一根根清楚；罗纹针织有清晰肌理，瑜伽裤哑光面料；发丝细密有碎发；杯壁有水汽，玻璃窗有反射。
【负面约束】塑料皮肤、娃娃脸、网红脸、过度磨皮、美颜滤镜、浓妆、3D渲染感、五官变形、手部变形、多余或缺失手指、手指粘连、成熟感、轻熟风、显老、法令纹、外套、披在肩上的外套、文字、水印、拼图。

entries.author: DeepBlueX0
entries.title: 明制凤冠霞帔新娘
entries.model: GPT Image 2.6 / Seedream 5.5 / Seedream 5.0 Pro / Muse Image / Nano Banana 2.1 / Grok Image 2.0
entries.note: 六张图从左到右依次对应六个模型。
entries.prompt:
中式传统婚礼新娘，成年东亚女性，完整全身站立，正面微微侧身，姿态自然端庄，身体重心稳定，双臂微微离开身体，双手自然下垂或轻轻交叠于身前，便于完整看清整套婚礼服饰的结构与层次。人物气质温婉典雅，端庄秀美，神情平静柔和，带轻微含蓄笑意。

她穿着一整套经典明制中式婚礼凤冠霞帔造型。头戴华美凤冠，冠体结构清晰华丽，饰有金色凤鸟纹、点翠感金饰、珠翠、珍珠垂饰、步摇与流苏，层次丰富且精致。发型为传统中式新娘盘发，发髻稳妥工整，与凤冠自然衔接。面容秀美，妆容精致雅致，保留真实皮肤纹理与自然立体五官，不过度磨皮。

服饰主体为典型明制婚礼服制：内层中式立领或圆领中衣，外层红色大袖嫁衣，肩背披挂完整霞帔，霞帔自肩部自然下垂，边缘纹样、前胸结构、披挂关系清楚可辨；下身为层叠式长裙或马面裙结构，裙摆完整展开但不过度飞扬；腰间有清晰腰封、丝绦、玉佩、流苏垂饰；脚穿精致中式绣花婚鞋。整套服饰以正红与金色为主，辅以少量珠白与翠色点缀，布满龙凤纹、牡丹纹、祥云纹、团花纹和金线刺绣。丝绸、织锦、缎面、金线、珠饰、金属饰件的材质差异明确，层次丰富，贵气华丽但真实自然。

强调服装各组成部分边界清晰、层级明确，凤冠、耳饰、霞帔、内层衣襟、外层嫁衣、大袖、腰封、裙装、绣花鞋、玉佩和流苏都应清楚可见，适合作为后续“逐件穿上、逐层叠加”的动画完成态底图。不要夸张飘带遮挡主体，不要复杂前景遮挡，不要大幅摆动裙摆，不要手持团扇、捧花、灯笼等额外道具，不要红盖头完全遮住脸部；如出现红盖头，可轻搭于后方或肩后，不影响面部与凤冠展示。

画面采用真实写实摄影风格，电影级但自然克制，低AI感，真实皮肤质感，真实服装褶皱，真实金属与珠饰反光，细节高清。构图为严格9:16竖版，全身完整入镜，头顶与裙摆都留有充足空间，主体位于画面中央略偏下，整体结构稳定，便于后续视频延展。镜头为正面全身人像视角，轻微人像透视，避免广角畸变，人物比例自然修长。

背景为简洁、干净、低干扰的中式室内婚礼空间，可为暖色调古典婚房、木质屏风、淡雅帷幔、红木陈设或克制的中式布景，但背景元素需弱化处理，不能喧宾夺主，不要杂乱家具，不要复杂人群，不要其他人物入镜。背景主要用于营造中式婚礼氛围，同时突出新娘与婚服本身。整体光线柔和均匀，服装轮廓清楚，红金色层次分明，人物面部、凤冠与霞帔细节完整可见。

整体目标是一张“经典明制凤冠霞帔婚礼最终完成态”的高质量底图：人物完整，服饰华丽，层次分明，结构清晰，背景简洁，便于后续制作“凤冠霞帔逐件穿上”的图层式动画。无字幕，无额外文字，无水印，无多人。左下角保留低调艺术署名“● DeepBlue”：实心圆点为纯#0B3D91 深蓝色，后接白色自然手写体“DeepBlue”，低调简洁，不喧宾夺主。

严格9:16竖版，单图。

entries.author: dreamydigiarts
entries.title: 黄金时刻草地上吃草莓的女孩
entries.prompt: A tanned young woman sits casually on a white blanket spread on green grass at golden hour. She is semi-reclined, leaning on one arm behind her, legs extended to one side. She brings a fresh strawberry to her lips with one hand, eyes gazing softly to the side. She wears a simple white cotton spaghetti-strap crop camisole top and tiny red and white gingham check micro shorts with a small ruffle hem. On her feet are white lace-top ankle socks and dark Hunter-style rubber boots. On her head sits a white broderie anglaise / eyelet fabric headscarf tied loosely, with long loose hair hanging out beneath it. Large round white statement earrings. Makeup is minimal — sun-kissed dewy skin, subtle mascara, natural lip. On the blanket nearby: a plate of strawberries, a bowl of crevices, a glass. A round wicker basket sits at the edge. Background shows a park with lush trees in warm golden late-afternoon sunlight. Shot at medium distance, slight low angle, eye level. Warm golden hour light with long soft shadows. Editorial film-like quality

entries.author: RykerStone123__
entries.title: 夜景照片变手绘水彩画
entries.note: 需上传自己的照片；作者说 Gemini、Grok、GPT Image 2.0 均可。
entries.prompt:
1....Prompt

Use the uploaded image as the exact composition and subject reference. Transform the original nighttime photograph into a delicate hand-painted watercolor art print, while preserving the recognizable scene and all major elements.

Recreate the Starbucks café centered in the foreground, with its dark low-profile building, clearly visible STARBUCKS sign, glowing warm interior lights, outdoor seating/windows, surrounding evergreen trees, minimalist street lamps, and the majestic snow-covered Mount Fuji rising directly behind the café. Preserve the original perspective, proportions, placement, and atmospheric depth.

Style: traditional Japanese-inspired watercolor illustration on warm ivory textured paper, elegant and minimal, with soft translucent washes, subtle pigment bleeding, visible paper grain, loose hand-painted brushwork, and naturally imperfect watercolor edges.

Use a restrained winter palette of deep cobalt blue, icy blue, soft cyan, muted navy, pale gray, and warm golden yellow from the café windows and signage. Paint Mount Fuji with delicate blue-gray snow shadows and atmospheric mist around its lower slopes. Keep the sky beautifully simplified into smooth watercolor gradients rather than photographic detail.

Create a premium minimalist stationery / gallery art-print composition with the illustration relatively small and centered, surrounded by generous blank cream-colored paper.

Under the illustration, add neat handwritten-style typography reading exactly:

“coffee · mist · mountain”
“a quiet moment”

Then below it:

“2024”

Typography should be small, understated, dark blue-gray ink, with authentic hand-lettered imperfections.

Important: Keep the Starbucks branding and sign clearly recognizable, preserve Mount Fuji’s distinctive shape, do not add people, cars, extra buildings, or unnecessary objects. No photorealism, no digital 3D look, no heavy outlines, no oversaturated colors. The final result should feel like a quiet, sophisticated Japanese watercolor travel print made by hand.

entries.title: 暖光极简美妆时尚特写
entries.prompt: Beauty fashion portrait in aesthetic sunlit glow / modern minimal glam / warm editorial. Warm, sensual, confident woman with natural appeal. Close-up (crop to chest). Accent on eyes, cheekbones, and skin texture. Neutral light background. Minimalism without unnecessary details. Model leans her head on her hand, creating a soft diagonal in the frame. Head slightly tilted to the side. One hand supports the head. Eyes looking directly at the camera - deep, calm, magnetic. Lips relaxed, naturally closed. Soft but confident pose. Hair loose, light natural texture. Part of the hair tucked behind the ear, part falling freely along the face. Soft side or slightly offset parting. Natural styling. Tight-fitting long-sleeve in a bright orange shade. Smooth fabric. Minimalist gold hoop earrings. Modern minimalism with a bright color accent. Glow editorial makeup: warm blending on eyes, emphasized lashes, light face sculpting, pronounced highlighter on cheekbones, nude lips with a soft satin finish. Warm directional light. Soft shadows. Light emphasizes skin glow, cheekbone volume, and fabric texture. Moderate contrast, sunny, editorial-level. Clean warm color correction. Accent on skin glow, orange saturation, and natural texture. Without aggressive retouching. Premium beauty campaign finish.
